name: Full Page Capture
description: Capture full webpages and export them as PNG, JPG, or PDF with local-only processing.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none';
